title: 第三十一章 令丘之凤第三十章 瞿如之舞
lines: 第三十一章：令丘之凤
管道尽头，不是岩壁，而是天空。
黄海涛从那个隐蔽的出口钻出来，发现自己身处一座高耸入云的孤峰之巅。这里就是《南山经》中记载的“令丘之山”。
“又东五百里，曰令丘之山，无草木，多火。其南有谷，曰中谷，条风自是出。有鸟焉，其状如枭，人面四目，有耳，其名曰颙，其鸣自号，见则天下大旱。”
但眼前的景象，与“多火”和“大旱”截然不同。
整座山峰被一层厚厚的、终年不化的积雪覆盖，但在雪线之上，却矗立着一片极其违和的、翠绿色的森林。那些树不是普通的针叶树，而是巨大的、长着扇形叶片的棕榈状植物，在寒风中摇曳，散发着勃勃生机。
“微气候？”黄海涛看着温度计，山顶的温度是零下二十度，但这些植物却郁郁葱葱，“地热？还是……”
他话音未落，一声清越的啼鸣从森林深处传来。
那声音不像鸟叫，更像是一段由长笛和编钟合奏出的旋律，悠远、空灵，带着一种说不出的神圣感。
紧接着，一只巨大的飞鸟从森林上空滑翔而过。
那是颙。
但它和《山海经》里描述的“枭”相去甚远。它的体型像一只巨大的孔雀，但羽毛呈现出七彩的琉璃光泽，在雪地的反光下，流转着梦幻般的光晕。它的头部确实像猫头鹰，但那张“人面”极其精致，五官清晰可辨，甚至能看出表情——那是一种悲悯、庄严的神情。最诡异的是它的眼睛，不是两只，而是四只，呈菱形排列，每一只眼睛都像一颗璀璨的宝石，正散发着柔和的光芒。
“四目……人面……这不是‘旱灾之鸟’。”黄海涛喃喃自语，“这是‘司雨之神’？”
那头“颙”在空中盘旋了一圈，四只眼睛同时看向黄海涛所在的位置。它没有攻击，而是发出一声更加婉转的啼鸣，然后收拢翅膀，轻盈地落在了森林边缘的一根枯木上。
就在这时，森林里走出一个人。
那是一个穿着白色长袍、须发皆白的老者，手里拄着一根青翠的竹杖。他的面容和之前见过的玄冥、帝台有几分相似，但更加平和，眼神中充满了智慧与慈爱。
“又一位……守山人？”黄海涛握紧了手中的尧光之玉，警惕地问道。
“不。”老者微微一笑，声音温和如春风，“我是‘听风者’。这座令丘之山，是记录风雨的‘留声机’。”
他指向那片翠绿的森林：“看到那些树了吗？它们不是普通的植物，是‘声纳木’。它们记录着这片大陆上每一次风的呼啸，每一滴雨的坠落。而那只‘颙’，是它们的‘调音师’。”
仿佛印证他的话，那头七彩巨鸟展开翅膀，发出一串复杂多变的鸣叫。随着它的啼鸣，森林里的“声纳木”开始微微颤动，扇形的叶片像无数个小扇子，开始有节奏地扇动，发出“沙沙”的声响，仿佛在为大鸟的歌声伴舞。
“你在‘步天’。”老者看着黄海涛，“但你走的路，太‘重’了。每一步都在这个世界上留下伤痕。你需要学会‘倾听’，而不是‘丈量’。”
他从袖中取出一枚青色的、用玉石雕成的叶子，递给黄海涛。
“这是‘令丘之钥’。当你感到迷茫，听不到自己的脚步声时，吹响它。它会带你找到‘风’的方向。”
黄海涛接过玉叶，入手温润，一股清凉的气流顺着手掌流入心田，让他原本因为长途跋涉而焦躁的心瞬间平静下来。
“张弛……他死了吗？”黄海涛突然问道，声音有些干涩。
老者沉默了片刻，看向远处的雪山：“张弛的选择，是‘燃烧’。有些火，注定要熄灭，才能照亮别人。他的路已经结束了。但你的路，还在风中延续。”
他顿了顿，目光变得深邃：“而且，你以为你只是在‘修补’这个世界吗？不。你走过的每一步，都在改变你自己。看看你的影子。”
黄海涛下意识地低头。
在雪地上，他的影子不再是单一的人形，而是重叠着几个模糊的轮廓——有单狐的敏捷，有石枭的坚韧，甚至有张弛那半人半兽的扭曲。
“你正在……变成这个世界的一部分。”老者轻声道，“这是‘步天’的代价。当你走完最后一站，你可能已经不再是原来的‘你’了。”
黄海涛心中一震，握紧了玉叶。
“现在，”老者指向森林深处，“去吧。‘颙’要歌唱了。那是只有‘纯净之心’才能听到的旋律。”
黄海涛深吸一口气，向着那片翠绿的、回荡着天籁之音的森林，走去。
令丘之凤，凤鸣岐山。
但他听到的，不是祥瑞之兆，而是自己灵魂深处，那正在被这个古老世界一点点重塑的回响。

Chapter 31: Lingqiu Zhifeng
1.
At the end of the pipe, there is not a rock wall, but the sky.
Huang Haitao emerged from the hidden exit and found himself on the top of a solitary peak that reached into the clouds. This is the "Lingqiu Mountain" recorded in the "Nanshan Sutra".
"Five hundred miles to the east, there is a mountain called Lingqiu. There is no grass or trees, but there are many fires. There is a valley in the south, called Zhonggu, where the wind comes out. There is a bird, which looks like an owl, has a human face with four eyes and ears. Its name is Zong, and its call is self-calling. When you see it, there will be a severe drought in the world."
But the scene before us is completely different from "many fires" and "severe drought".
The entire mountain peak is covered by a thick layer of snow that never melts all year round, but above the snow line, there is an extremely inconsistent, emerald green forest. Those trees are not ordinary conifers, but huge, palm-like plants with fan-shaped leaves, swaying in the cold wind, exuding vitality.
"Microclimate?" Huang Haitao looked at the thermometer. The temperature on the top of the mountain was minus 20 degrees, but the plants were lush and lush. "Geothermal heat? Or..."
Before he finished speaking, a clear cry came from the depths of the forest.
The sound was not like a bird's call, but more like a melody played by a flute and chimes. It was distant, ethereal, and had an indescribable sense of holiness.
Then, a huge bird glided over the forest.
That's Yong.
But it is far from the "Owl" described in "The Classic of Mountains and Seas". It is shaped like a giant peacock, but its feathers show a colorful glazed luster. Under the reflection of the snow, there is a dreamy halo. Its head does look like an owl, but its "human face" is extremely delicate, its facial features are clearly distinguishable, and its expression can even be seen - it is a compassionate and solemn expression. The weirdest thing is that it has not two eyes, but four, arranged in a diamond shape. Each eye is like a bright gem, emitting a soft light.
"Four eyes... human face... this is not the 'drought bird'." Huang Haitao murmured to himself, "This is the 'god of rain'?"
The "Yong" circled in the air, and its four eyes looked at Huang Haitao's position at the same time. It did not attack, but let out a more gentle cry, then folded its wings and landed lightly on a dead tree at the edge of the forest.
At this moment, a man walked out of the forest.
It was an old man wearing a white robe with white beard and hair, holding a green bamboo stick in his hand. His face was somewhat similar to Xuan Ming and Di Tai that he had seen before, but it was calmer and his eyes were full of wisdom and kindness.
"Another... mountain guard?" Huang Haitao clenched the Yaoguang Jade in his hand and asked warily.
"No." The old man smiled slightly, his voice as gentle as the spring breeze, "I am a 'listener to the wind.' This mountain of Lingqiu is a 'gramophone' that records wind and rain."
He pointed to the green forest: "Have you seen those trees? They are not ordinary plants, they are 'sonar trees'. They record every roar of the wind and every drop of rain on this continent. And that 'harp' is their 'tuner'."
As if to confirm his words, the colorful giant bird spread its wings and let out a series of complex and changeable chirps. As it cries, the "sonar wood" in the forest begins to tremble slightly, and the fan-shaped blades, like countless small fans, begin to flap rhythmically, making a "rustling" sound, as if dancing to the song of the big bird.
"You are in 'Bu Tian'." The old man looked at Huang Haitao, "But the road you are walking is too 'heavy'. Every step leaves scars on this world. You need to learn to 'listen' instead of 'measure'."
He took out a green leaf carved from jade from his sleeve and handed it to Huang Haitao.
"This is the 'Key of Lingqiu'. When you feel confused and can't hear your own footsteps, blow it. It will lead you to the direction of the 'wind'."
Huang Haitao took the jade leaf and warmed it in his hands. A stream of cool air flowed down his palm into his heart, instantly calming down his anxious heart due to the long journey.
"Zhang Chi... is he dead?" Huang Haitao suddenly asked, his voice a little dry.
The old man was silent for a moment and looked at the snow-capped mountains in the distance: "Zhang Chi's choice is to 'burn'. Some fires are destined to be extinguished in order to illuminate others. His road has ended. But your road continues in the wind."
He paused and his eyes became deep: "And, do you think you are just 'fixing' the world? No. Every step you take, you are changing yourself. Look at your shadow."
Huang Haitao lowered his head subconsciously.
On the snow, his shadow was no longer a single human figure, but overlapping with several blurry outlines - the agility of a single fox, the tenacity of a stone owl, and even the twist of Zhang Chi's half-man, half-beast.
"You are... becoming part of this world." The old man said softly, "This is the price of 'Bu Tian'. When you finish the last stop, you may no longer be the original 'you'."
Huang Haitao was shocked and held Yu Ye tightly.
"Now," the old man pointed to the depths of the forest, "go. The 'Yong' is about to sing. That is a melody that only the 'Pure Heart' can hear."
Huang Haitao took a deep breath and walked towards the emerald green forest that echoed with the sounds of nature.
The phoenix of Lingqiu, the phoenix of Qishan.
But what he heard was not an auspicious omen, but the echo deep in his soul, which was being reshaped bit by bit by this ancient world.
